desc: DONE as the hardened candidate-pattern milestone. Strict direct-right-HPM2 candidates built reproducibly with bounded transport, raw-before-validation logging, exact endpoint gates, separated linked boundaries, and no forbidden operations. Live diagnostics then evolved the artifacts without weakening the pattern: 093 passed the corrected raw+translated address gate and found the inactive selector; 094's narrowed binary sent WAKEUP and read state 0x07; 095's narrowed binary sent only DATA1 00 + CMD1 SSPS and read final state 0x00. All three are done. The original interrupt-mask candidate was never run and was removed from 095; mask/W1C handling remains untested. Exact final live hashes live in tickets 093–095 and their result docs.
